args.title: Add TSV export format alongside CSV and XLSX
args.body: File: src/exportUtils.ts. Add "tsv" to the SUPPORTED_FORMATS list (and ExportFormat type) so reports can be exported as tab-delimited files, which the warehouse loader requires. A corresponding writeTsv function (likely reusing the CSV writer logic with a tab delimiter) should be wired into the export dispatch in src/api/reports.ts, but the format should be declared and validated starting in exportUtils.ts.
